scope.surface: Complete six-page F1000Research Brief Report and identical-body arXiv route
scope.notes: All sections are covered; the central equation, table, caption and availability surface receive finer-grained review. Paragraph-level necessity was checked contextually during hostile review.

elements.reader_question: What bounded scientific observation does this article establish?
elements.incoming_dependency: Frozen authored holdout, deterministic conformance battery and current literature positioning.
elements.contribution: Presents one fixed-panel methods observation and one deterministic interface-conformance result as a short report.
elements.outgoing_dependency: All sections jointly establish the bounded claim and its limits.
elements.deletion_consequence: The scientific contribution would have no standalone publication surface.
elements.placement_reason: The report is the primary public account of the bounded observation.
elements.representation_reason: A Brief Report matches the small scientific mass better than a full-length article.

redundancy.reason: No other element performs the whole-paper synthesis.

elements.reader_question: What was tested, what happened and what remains unproved?
elements.incoming_dependency: Headline methods, results and authority ceiling.
elements.contribution: States the 32-case holdout, eight-state conformance mass, six false merges, null control and explicit exclusions.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Sets expectations for every later section and portal metadata.
elements.deletion_consequence: Readers and the journal portal would lose the required standalone summary.
elements.placement_reason: F1000Research requires an abstract at the beginning.
elements.representation_reason: Background, Methods, Results and Conclusions labels expose the argument without bullet-like limitations prose.

redundancy.reason: It previews the body but is independently required for discovery and triage.

elements.reader_question: Where does the claim-relative merge rule sit relative to extraction, ontology matching and semantic-interoperability work?
elements.incoming_dependency: Nearest external literature and the raw-text exclusion.
elements.contribution: Defines the downstream decision problem and narrows novelty against named neighbouring programmes.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Justifies the evaluated rule and short-report contribution.
elements.deletion_consequence: The paper would appear to overclaim category-wide novelty or replace upstream systems.
elements.placement_reason: Positioning must precede the method.
elements.representation_reason: Continuous prose connects the problem, prior work and exact contribution boundary.

redundancy.reason: No later section establishes the full prior-work boundary.

elements.reader_question: How were decisions, scientific units, comparators and diagnostics fixed?
elements.incoming_dependency: Frozen protocol and evaluated structured records.
elements.contribution: Groups the complete design needed to interpret the fixed-panel results.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Licences the quantitative and mechanistic statements in Results.
elements.deletion_consequence: Results would be uninterpretable and irreproducible.
elements.placement_reason: Design information belongs before results.
elements.representation_reason: Four short subsections separate rule, units, comparators and deterministic conformance.

redundancy.reason: The section is the sole design account.

elements.reader_question: What information enters the rule and what outcomes can it emit?
elements.incoming_dependency: Structured-projection design.
elements.contribution: Defines the coordinate tuple and three decision outcomes without implying raw-text inference.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports comparator-interface and ablation interpretation.
elements.deletion_consequence: The claimed mechanism would be undefined.
elements.placement_reason: The rule must be defined before panels and comparisons.
elements.representation_reason: Compact prose plus one tuple equation is the shortest precise representation.

redundancy.reason: No other subsection defines the evaluated object.

elements.location: Section 2.2 Fixed panels and scientific units
elements.reader_question: What is the independent scientific mass and how was the holdout frozen?
elements.incoming_dependency: Development and holdout registries.
elements.contribution: Separates 32 case scores from three authored families and discloses source and authorship dependence.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Controls uncertainty language and external-validity claims.
elements.deletion_consequence: The manuscript would pseudoreplicate cases and conceal designer advantage.
elements.placement_reason: Scientific-unit accounting is a design property.
elements.representation_reason: Prose can state case, family and custody dependence without a misleading sample-size table.

redundancy.reason: This is the only complete scientific-mass statement.

elements.reader_question: What roles do the baselines and fixed-panel diagnostics play?
elements.incoming_dependency: Registered false-merge and false-split gates.
elements.contribution: Discloses the deliberately weak comparator, conservative control, decision margins and descriptive bootstrap.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Prevents general superiority and population-inference readings of the results.
elements.deletion_consequence: The main difference would be scientifically uninterpretable.
elements.placement_reason: Comparator roles and decision rules must precede observed values.
elements.representation_reason: Prose retains the non-compensatory gates and all interpretive cautions together.

redundancy.reason: No other element gives the full comparator contract.

elements.reader_question: Why are 400 records only eight mechanism states, and why is one comparison interface-mismatched?
elements.incoming_dependency: Frozen generator and comparator interfaces.
elements.contribution: Explains the five-by-eight-by-ten construction, effective state count and terminal-alphabet mismatch.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Constrains the 400/400 and 250/400 result interpretation.
elements.deletion_consequence: Record counts would be mistaken for independent observations and the comparator score for capability superiority.
elements.placement_reason: The battery's construction belongs before its outcome.
elements.representation_reason: A concise factorization exposes dependence more clearly than a large record table.

redundancy.reason: Only this subsection defines effective conformance mass.

elements.reader_question: What happened on development, holdout, ablations and conformance checks?
elements.incoming_dependency: Defined rules, units, gates and fixed records.
elements.contribution: Reports all headline, negative, null, identity-control and interface-attainability outcomes.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supplies the evidence interpreted in Discussion.
elements.deletion_consequence: The article would contain no empirical result.
elements.placement_reason: Observed outcomes follow the methods that define them.
elements.representation_reason: One compact table plus prose keeps all nulls visible without inflating a short report.

redundancy.reason: The Results section is the authoritative outcome surface.

elements.reader_question: Which coordinates comprise a source projection?
elements.incoming_dependency: Coordinate names introduced by the mechanism.
elements.contribution: Provides a single exact tuple that later prose can reference without repeated lists.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports rule, ablation and missing-coordinate explanations.
elements.deletion_consequence: The formal object would become diffuse and harder to verify.
elements.placement_reason: The tuple is central and compact enough to merit display.
elements.representation_reason: Mathematical tuple notation exposes coordinate separability more precisely than prose alone.

redundancy.reason: Nearby prose defines symbols, but the display supplies their joint structure.

elements.reader_question: How do accuracy, false merges, false splits and abstention compare on the holdout?
elements.incoming_dependency: One decision per holdout case under three rules.
elements.contribution: Shows all registered holdout outcome rates in one inspectable display.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Anchors the six-false-merge and zero-false-split discussion.
elements.deletion_consequence: Readers could not efficiently verify the complete cross-rule outcome pattern.
elements.placement_reason: Four aligned measures across three rules are clearer in a table than repeated prose.
elements.representation_reason: A small numeric table is the least complex faithful display.

redundancy.reason: Headline numbers recur in prose, while the table uniquely shows the full rate matrix.

elements.reader_question: What population, unit and diagnostics does the table represent?
elements.incoming_dependency: Table rates and paired diagnostics.
elements.contribution: Binds the display to 32 holdout cases and labels both intervals as fixed-panel diagnostics.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Prevents population-like interpretation of the table.
elements.deletion_consequence: The table would lack its unit and uncertainty semantics.
elements.placement_reason: Display semantics must travel with the table.
elements.representation_reason: A self-contained caption supports standalone reading and extraction.

redundancy.reason: Methods gives full detail, while the caption must retain the local interpretation.

elements.reader_question: What can and cannot be concluded from the observed pattern?
elements.incoming_dependency: Complete holdout, ablation, conformance and identity-control results.
elements.contribution: Interprets the polarity mechanism and preserves comparator, custody, dependence and transport limitations in continuous prose.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Defines the final authority ceiling and optional successor evidence.
elements.deletion_consequence: The paper would invite overclaiming and leave limitations mechanically disconnected from the result.
elements.placement_reason: Interpretation follows evidence.
elements.representation_reason: Paragraphs integrate limits with the result rather than using a mechanical point-form limitations list.

redundancy.reason: Only Discussion performs complete scientific interpretation.

elements.reader_question: Where are the exact records, software and protocols, and what persistent deposit is still missing?
elements.incoming_dependency: Pinned public repository snapshot, licences and redistribution limits.
elements.contribution: Provides one immutable snapshot URL, licence boundaries and an honest statement that no repository DOI is yet asserted.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports reviewer access and identifies the remaining F1000 filing blocker.
elements.deletion_consequence: The journal's data policy and reproducibility route would not be satisfied.
elements.placement_reason: Journal policy requires a designated availability section.
elements.representation_reason: One pinned URL avoids internal repository-path leakage while preserving exact access.

redundancy.reason: This is the only manuscript-facing access and licence statement.

elements.reader_question: Did the work involve regulated participants, personal data or animals?
elements.incoming_dependency: Computational study design.
elements.contribution: States non-applicability without inventing an approval record.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Closes the journal declaration surface.
elements.deletion_consequence: A mandatory applicability statement would be missing.
elements.placement_reason: Declarations follow the scientific body.
elements.representation_reason: One sentence is sufficient for a non-human computational study.

redundancy.reason: No other declaration covers ethics applicability.

elements.reader_question: Who performed and is accountable for the work?
elements.incoming_dependency: Single-author contribution record.
elements.contribution: Provides the complete contribution roles for the named author.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports attribution and accountability.
elements.deletion_consequence: Required contribution information would be absent.
elements.placement_reason: Contribution declarations belong after the scientific body.
elements.representation_reason: A compact role list is sufficient for one author.

redundancy.reason: No other element records contribution roles.

elements.reader_question: Were competing interests disclosed?
elements.incoming_dependency: Author disclosure.
elements.contribution: Uses the journal's stock no-competing-interests declaration.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports editorial transparency.
elements.deletion_consequence: A required journal declaration would be missing.
elements.placement_reason: The declaration follows author contributions.
elements.representation_reason: Exact stock wording avoids ambiguity.

redundancy.reason: No other manuscript section supplies this declaration.

elements.reader_question: Did grants support the work?
elements.incoming_dependency: Author funding disclosure.
elements.contribution: Uses the journal's stock no-grants declaration.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Supports funding transparency.
elements.deletion_consequence: A required journal declaration would be missing.
elements.placement_reason: The declaration follows competing interests.
elements.representation_reason: Exact stock wording avoids inventing funder authority.

redundancy.reason: No other manuscript section supplies this declaration.

elements.reader_question: How was generative AI used and who retained responsibility?
elements.incoming_dependency: Documented OpenAI Codex assistance and author verification duties.
elements.contribution: Discloses language, literature-search and submission-file assistance while excluding AI-produced research data.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Triggers the author's final independent review of wording, table and formula under live journal policy.
elements.deletion_consequence: The article would conceal material AI assistance.
elements.placement_reason: The disclosure belongs with end-matter declarations.
elements.representation_reason: Plain prose distinguishes assistance from scientific authorship and data creation.

redundancy.reason: No other manuscript element provides the full AI-use disclosure.

elements.reader_question: Which external works support positioning and method context?
elements.incoming_dependency: Citations used in Introduction and methods context.
elements.contribution: Provides complete bibliographic routes to the named nearest work and upstream programmes.
elements.outgoing_dependency: Allows reviewers to verify novelty and context.
elements.deletion_consequence: Positioning claims would become unauditable.
elements.placement_reason: References conventionally close the manuscript.
elements.representation_reason: A standard bibliography is the most compact verifiable form.

redundancy.reason: No other element provides full bibliographic records.

notes: Every section has a declared scientific, rhetorical, reproducibility or compliance function.
The equation, table, caption and availability section were audited at finer granularity because they carry formal, quantitative and filing authority.
Final journal filing still depends on the human actions listed in the public package.
